title: Less-repeated Skills picks
reader_summary: Remember more of the recent Skills list and penalize repeats harder, so more unique repos show up week to week.
outcome_line: Kept. Treatment mean consecutive-day top-10 overlap was 37.5% (baseline 70%); 82 unique repos and 26.2% NEW share in top 10 over 13 digests.
how_we_measure: We compare consecutive-day top-10 overlap, unique repos per week, and NEW share in the top 10 from digest.json. Success bar: overlap down at least 15 percentage points vs the 70% baseline. PostHog clicks are secondary and sparse.
hypothesis: Stronger soft-dedup (14-day window, 0.15 penalty) reduces consecutive-day list overlap and raises weekly unique / NEW share on Skills digests, while still ranking by 7-day momentum so the list stays about discovery of real activity.
change_summary: Tighten soft-dedup for Skills digests only: DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_BRIEFINGS=14 and DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_PENALTY=0.15 (defaults today: 5 and 0.5).
verdict: Treatment window 2026-09-13→2026-09-26 (13 Skills digests through 2026-09-25; 2026-09-26 digest not in repo at close). From digest.json: mean consecutive-day top-10 overlap 37.5% vs 70.0% baseline (−32.5pp, clears the ≥15pp success bar); 82 unique repos across 130 top-10 slots vs 33/140 baseline; 26.2% of top-10 slots marked is_new vs 4.3% baseline. Secondary PostHog pageviews/clicks were not exported in the cloud agent (placeholder CSV: 0 aggregate outbound clicks). **Keep** DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_BRIEFINGS=14 and DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_PENALTY=0.15 on the Skills digest command.
notes: Closed 2026-09-26 PT. Baseline diversity: 14 digests, 70.0% mean overlap, 33 unique repos / 140 slots, 4.3% is_new (digest.json). Treatment diversity: 13 digests (missing 2026-09-26), 37.5% mean overlap, 82 unique repos / 130 slots, 26.2% is_new. PostHog secondary not fetched in cloud agent; primary gate is digest diversity only. Soft-dedup flags kept on Skills digest; OSS defaults unchanged; ponytail narration flags remain on Skills. Backlog: RANK-2. Lab post: briefings/lab/posts/EXP-20260715-soft-dedup-diversity-skills.md.
